name: ticker
description: A plain-words line in the spinner row while a long shell command runs, so you can see what the command is doing without opening it.

summaries.title: Who writes the line
summaries.description: haiku: Haiku turns the counted facts into a sentence, about every 20 seconds while the command prints and every 60 seconds while it is quiet. Each call counts against your plan or API key. rules: the mod's own rules write the line and no model is called.
